es.aviso: Es un perro con mucha fuerza. Hace falta ser consciente de ello y estar capacitado para manejar este tipo de perro.

en.resumen: Former security dog. Calm and affectionate, but very powerful: he needs experienced hands.
en.historia: Sherouk was a working security dog. When the company shut down, the dogs were left behind. We found him in very poor condition; he is much better now, but he still lives in a cage in the jungle, waiting for a family.
en.aviso: He is a very powerful dog. You need to be aware of that and properly equipped to handle this kind of dog.

en.resumen: A second chance for a loyal friend
en.historia: He was adopted at two months old and was happy for a year... until a trip his owners took led to him being returned to the shelter—through no fault of his own. Wayu already knows what it’s like to have a home; all he needs now is a family that will stay with him forever. Could it be you? Write to us!

es.resumen: Pirata es un perro muy alegre, de temperamento muy tranquilo. Se lleva bien con otros perros como con las personas y niños
es.historia:
Disfruta de los paseos,  pasea bien con correa, le encanta que lo acaricien y recibir mimos. Se mantiene tranquilo en lugares y se porta muy bien cuando viaja en coche. 🚗 Es muy limpio, ya que espera a los paseos para hacer sus necesidades.
Tiene un carácter muy dulce y es sumamente inteligente! Le gusta jugar con sus juguetes, sabe sentarse y dar la patita.
Pirata fue rescatado por la calle , un hombre en estado de ebriedad le dio una patada tan violenta que le provocó la pérdida de un ojo 😭

en.resumen: Pirata is a very cheerful dog with a very calm temperament. He gets along well with other dogs, as well as with people and children.
en.historia:
He enjoys walks and walks well on a leash; he loves being petted and receiving affection. He stays calm in various settings and behaves very well when traveling by car. 🚗 He is very clean, as he waits until his walks to relieve himself.
He has a very sweet temperament and is extremely intelligent! He enjoys playing with his toys, and he knows how to sit and "shake" (offer his paw).
Pirata was rescued from the streets; an alcoholic man kicked him so violently that he lost an eye. 😭

es.resumen: Ronaldo es un perro hermoso, valiente y muy sociable
es.historia:
Tiene mucha energía, le encanta estar rodeado de otros y se lleva muy bien con otros perros. Sería un compañero maravilloso para familias con niños y para personas activas que deseen compartir momentos de juego, cariño y compañía.
A pesar de las dificultades que ha enfrentado, Ronaldo tiene mucho amor para dar y merece encontrar una familia que lo quiera y lo cuide para siempre. 💙Ronaldo sufrió una lesión en una de sus patas debido a maltratos previos, lo que le dificulta caminar con normalidad.
Necesita una familia cariñosa y comprensiva que tenga en cuenta su condición, evite las caminatas largas y respete sus límites. Aunque tiene mucha energía y ganas de vivir, es importante cuidar su pata y adaptar las actividades a sus necesidades.
Si buscas un compañero sociable, valiente y lleno de vida, Ronaldo está esperando su oportunidad para formar parte de tu familia.

en.resumen: Ronaldo is a beautiful, brave, and very sociable dog.
en.historia:
He has lots of energy, loves being around others, and gets along very well with other dogs.He would make a wonderful companion for families with children and active people who want to share moments of play, affection, and companionship.
Despite the difficulties he has faced, Ronaldo has so much love to give and deserves to find a family that will love and care for him forever. 💙Ronaldo suffered an injury to one of his paws due to past abuse, which makes it difficult for him to walk normally. He needs a loving and understanding family who will be mindful of his condition, avoid long walks, and respect his limits. Although he has lots of energy and a zest for life, it is important to take care of his paw and adapt activities to his needs.
If you’re looking for a sociable, brave, and lively companion, Ronaldo is waiting for his chance to become part of your family
